content.overview: Section 18 of the Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act, 1956 gives a Hindu wife the right to be maintained by her husband during her lifetime. She is entitled to live separately without forfeiting maintenance on specified grounds (desertion, cruelty, virulent disease, conversion, other justifying cause). She loses the claim if she is unchaste or ceases to be a Hindu by conversion.
content.glance: Ask: (1) Hindu wife? (2) Husband’s duty? (3) Separate residence grounds? (4) Forfeiture for unchastity/conversion?
content.study:
s. 18(1) — right to maintenance by husband during lifetime.
s. 18(2) — separate residence without forfeiture on listed grounds.
s. 18(3) — no entitlement if unchaste or ceases to be a Hindu.

Distinct from HMA ss. 24–25 (matrimonial proceedings) and CrPC/BNSS maintenance. Coordinate to avoid double recovery.

No case holdings invented. Case-law verification remains a separate gate.

sections.heading: Primary right
sections.body: Hindu wife entitled to be maintained by her husband during her lifetime.

sections.heading: Separate residence
sections.body: May live separately without forfeiting claim on desertion, cruelty, virulent disease, conversion of husband, or other justifying cause.

sections.heading: Forfeiture
sections.body: Unchastity or conversion of the wife ends the claim under s. 18(3).

sections.heading: Parallel remedies
sections.body: HMA interim/permanent maintenance and CrPC/BNSS claims may coexist; courts avoid double recovery.

sections.heading: Quantum
sections.body: Guided by needs and means under the HAMA scheme (see related maintenance sections).

examples.title: Cruelty and separate residence
examples.body: Wife lives separately for cruelty — may claim maintenance under s. 18 without forfeiture.

hypotheticals.question: Does conversion of the wife end s. 18 maintenance?
hypotheticals.analysis: Yes. s. 18(3) disentitles a wife who ceases to be a Hindu by conversion.

misconceptions.trap: Wife always loses maintenance if she lives separately.
misconceptions.correction: s. 18(2) lists grounds for separate residence without forfeiture.
